prompt: A woman's pale translucent spirit floating up near the ceiling of a dim hospital ICU room at night, looking down at her own physical body lying in the bed far below — the body on a ventilator with tubes, a code team in scrubs rushing around it. Her spirit face is calm but puzzled, as if she does not recognize that the body is herself.

A woman's spirit gently lifting up and away from her own collapsed physical body on the ground, turning to look back down at it with detached wonder — one leg of the body grotesquely swollen to three times its normal size, discolored brownish-green like the skin of a snake. Quiet, eerie, dreamlike.
